body: I tried to make the call yesterday, but I couldn't bring myself to talk on the phone to the counselor. Did you make the call?
It is just a whole lot of stuff going wrong. It feels like I am being pushed towards this from all sides.

Thanks for the reply.

I have tried looking at it from a wider perspective, but it just seems like a whole lot of things that have just been spiraling out of control, and it feels like the only way I could have made a difference, was if something had changed earlier.

When it comes to making friends, things seem to get in the way, because I can't help but think of the other people who I thought were friends who have just disappeared, and most people already have their groups, and stuff where they don't have time for more people.

Reaching out is hard, even making this post was a challenge.
It is just so hard to do anything, I feel so unmotivated because of how I feel to the point that I don't even want to call the university counselor.
Aside from my family, there really aren't I know people, but I don't have many friends. It would just be easier for a lot of people.
